breakdown: 📊 Scoreboard lately - Broncos: 25 scored, 18 allowed a game (last 3). Panthers: 19 and 28. We been better.
🏟️ Panthers at home this season: 1-2. Their own crowd's been watching 'em lose.
🚑 Panthers are down Will Lee III (CB), Bobby Okereke (LB) today.
🥊 The Panthers got smacked 43-13 by the Buccaneers inside their last 5. That's who we're going against.
🧊 Panthers are 3-4 and ice cold — 2 straight L's.
🧯 Coaching change for the Panthers — "Panthers bring back DeAngelo Hall as CB coach in 1st move since Evero firing"
🔥 Broncos can't stop winning: 4 straight, 6-2 overall.
📅 How they came in: Broncos W 28-24 vs Chiefs · Panthers L 19-27 @ Packers.
🎯 The quarterbacks - Bo Nix (Broncos): 3 TDs, 0 picks and 551 yards in his last 3 games. Bryce Young (Panthers): 4 TDs, 3 picks and 653 yards in his last 3 games.
📊 Everybody and they mama on the Broncos: 89% of the bets, 94% of the money.
🧳 Broncos are 2-2 on the road so far.
⚠️ Heads up: Broncos go without Kris Abrams-Draine (CB), Brandon Jones (S). Still Broncos.
✅ Bottom line: Broncos (-142). We'd lay -165 on Broncos - getting -142. Easy money.
🍀 Jets been unlucky, not bad: add their shooting % and save % over the last 10 and you get 95.4, under the 100 a normal team runs.
📅 Lightning is off a 4-3 win over the Wild themselves. One of 'em takes an L tonight.
🧯 The Lightning got a guy wanting out: "Back on home ice after trade request, Kucherov has two assists in Lightning wins"
🧳 3-5 on the road for Lightning this season. They hate leaving the house.
📋 Jets are 6-11 after a 6-2 win over the Canucks.
📊 90% of the bets on the Lightning. Let the public have 'em.
⚠️ Biggest knock on Jets: Andrei Vasilevskiy (Lightning, projected, not confirmed) is at a 0.912 save % over his last 3 starts to Stuart Skinner's 0.831.
✅ Bottom line: Jets (+124). Line makers ain't showing no respect to Jets at +124 - we make 'em +111.
🏟️ Bruins are 7-1 at home this year. Tough out in their own house.
📅 Last outing: Bruins W 6-2 @ Penguins · Panthers L 3-4 @ Capitals.
🧳 Panthers on the road this season: 5-6. Road trips ain't their thing.
💪 Bruins (12-5) vs Panthers (9-8) — the better team is on our side.
🚑 Panthers gotta play without Sandis Vilmanis (LW).
🥅 Jacob Markstrom, projected to start for the Panthers (not confirmed yet), can't keep the puck out lately: a 0.859 save % (10 goals on 71 shots) over his last 3 starts.
🛡️ On the year Bruins allow 2.4 a game, Panthers 3.0. Our D shows up.
🔥 Bruins are 12-5 and on a 3-game heater.
📊 The public's with us: 83% of the bets, 86% of the money on the Bruins.
⚠️ What scares us a little: Panthers got Bruins last time these two met, a 2-1 loss to the Panthers.
✅ Bottom line: Bruins (-142). We price Bruins at -142 - -142 is extra money. We'll take it.
🚑 Buccaneers out: LB Yaya Diaby (starter) · questionable: WR Emeka Egbuka (starter).
🧳 Road game, no problem: Buccaneers are 2-1 away from home this season.
⏳ Fresher legs on our side - Buccaneers had 7 days off, Bears 6 days.
🥊 The Bears got their cheeks clapped 31-7 by the Packers inside their last 5.
📊 Over the last 3, Buccaneers are a +13 team a game (26 for, 13 against); Bears are +11 (32 for, 21 against).
📋 3-5 for Buccaneers, last time out a 16-0 win over the Falcons.
📊 The Bears got 68% of the tickets (67% of the money). We got the Buccaneers.
📅 The Bears won their last one too, a 34-17 win over the Seahawks.
⚠️ Biggest knock on Buccaneers: Bears come in on a 3-game heater.
🟡 Bottom line: Buccaneers +6 (-108). Buccaneers cover +6 a hair more often than not for us. Just a lean.
⏳ Flyers got the extra day: 3 days off to Flames' 2 days.
🚑 Flames are without Connor Zary (C).
📊 Last 3: Flyers score 3 and give up 3 a game; Flames score 2 and give up 3.
🥊 The Avalanche put 5-2 on the Flames in one of their last 5.
🎲 Flyers' record sits 7 points under what their goals for and against say it should be. They better than the standings.
📅 The Flames come in off a 5-3 loss to the Ducks; the Flyers off a 3-2 loss to the Rangers.
📋 Flyers are 4-14 after a 3-2 loss to the Rangers.
⚠️ The other side's best argument: Devin Cooley (Flames) is at a 0.957 save % over his last 3 starts to Joseph Woll's 0.854 (our guy in net last time out).
🟡 Bottom line: Flyers (-118). A coin flip - if you're playing it, Flyers are the side. No units from us.
